editorial:
Imagine being a cop who has lost everything and has nothing left but a need for revenge. That is exactly where you find the main character, played by William Baldwin. He is on a mission to hunt down the person who killed his wife, but things get messy when he teams up with a group of rogue agents. The movie feels like a classic turn-of-the-century thriller where the lines between the good guys and bad guys get blurred very quickly. You get a mix of gritty city streets and high-stakes tension that keeps you wondering who to trust.

What really works here is how the story flips on its head once the main character becomes the prime suspect in a murder. The pacing stays quick, though some of the plot twists might feel a bit predictable if you watch a lot of crime shows. It is a solid pick if you want something easy to watch on a Friday night. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV to see the action clearly. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this thriller handy.
endingExplained: In the end, you discover that the rogue operation was a setup from the start. The main character manages to clear his name by exposing the corrupt people who tried to frame him for murder. After a final showdown where he finally gets justice for his wife, he is able to leave the chaos behind. He essentially wipes the slate clean and starts a brand new life away from the lies and betrayal.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime mysteries and revenge stories.
